summary: We as Harvester created a map for astronauts to follow. This map explores the area of Aeolis Mons and Aeolis Paulus. This area is near the location of the landing site of the rover "Curiosity". Astronauts will want to retrieve the rover and also examine the rock formations it took the photos of, So we created an interactive map and route for astronauts to follow while exploring near the Curiosity landing site.
details: This projects shows a map mission of the curiosity landing site, provides astronauts a route and an interactive map for them to follow. Also view points, camps and sample extracting spots are also marked on the map. This benefits astronauts by showing them the most efficent and safe path to view the formations near the Curiosity landing site. İts the easiest way to show the astronauts the map. Also under the interactive map in the website there is a part which says the risks and precautions needed to take. We sadly needed to use Claude AI by Antropic because we do not know how to code and develop a website, this was only used to make the website all the information was gathered by us and the map was hand drawn by us. This is creative because nobody really decided to draw a route near the Curiosity landing site and provide a interactive map for astronauts there which will help them retrieve the rover. We considered the risks of the mission and the time it takes to complete it. We estimated that it can be done in 1 day with short brakes and the astronaut team can set up a camp if needed. We also looked at unsafe spots (like the Bagnold Dunes) near the landing site and avoided entering it. We considered the time it would take to create a map and route like this.
